items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I liked Nick LaRocca, the way he played a melody, and I liked the sound of his melody and his cornet.

ctx.x: You had to buy them under the race label and so consequently in the music stores where you'd go in and go into a booth, they wouldn't give you -- you'd have to ask for them, and many cases they didn't have them. Because they were interested in selling "Margie" and things like that that they had a lot of, "Whispering" and "Avalon" and all those things.
The jazz part that I liked was -- I liked Nick LaRocca, the way he played a melody, and I liked the sound of his melody and his cornet.

So that I would say if I ever got excited about playing a jazz chorus, it would be maybe along that line. Or I would be going up and down the -- well, not too much of that. get into I liked to listen to a little bit of rhythm. Most saxophone
